title: Quote of the day by Leo Tolstoy: 'Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one...'
summary_full: According to Leo Tolstoy, true societal change begins with personal evolution. He asserted that individuals must first address their own imperfections. This mindset has significantly shaped leaders like Mahatma Gandhi and Martin Luther King Jr. However, in our contemporary society, there is a trend toward prioritizing external grievances over internal growth. To achieve meaningful advancements, it is essential to blend personal honesty with systemic change.
